say:1:1421239001:0.text: You two can share these gifts.

say:9:1421239008:1.text: Master Feli experienced the beauty of the surface, and I heard that he even planted mirage blooms there... He longed for a world under the sun...
say:9:1421239008:1.source_cn: 斐利尔大人体味过地表的美好，我听说他还在地表上种过幻影...

say:10:1421239009:1.text: I want people here to experience Master Feli's special forest and feel what he once felt...
say:10:1421239009:1.source_cn: 我想要让更多人在这里……在斐利尔大人的林地里，见一见斐...

say:11:1421239010:1.source_cn: 好，这几片实验林地，就交给你打理了。
